briefing: World and Tech are not covered today because no new stories could be confirmed. HHS approved Medicaid waivers for Native American traditional healing in Utah and Maine. Democrats in Georgia, Kansas and Texas see Medicaid expansion as a priority. In Idaho, a legislative report found drug possession prison sentences surged over two decades.
